messages:
Elaine C: quick RFC follow-up — proposing an "offline healthcheck + stochastic retry" playbook for airgapped package activation. gist below.

Mike L: sounds useful. what's the difference from our current resumed-sync loop? :thinking: 

Elaine C: current loop just retries fetches until timeout. this adds: local activation probes, randomized exponential backoff, and a deterministic "rebase" that re-applies missing manifest links to avoid stuck partial-activations.

Raj P: concrete failure cases? iirc we've seen devices where transfer stalled at 96% forever and operator had to manually kill the agent.

Elaine C: exactly. cases:
- long transfer + intermittent disk IO spikes
- partial manifest write leaving state machine in "applying"
- seed-transfer that completes but activation fails due to ordering

Sasha: +1 on deterministic rebase. we should also bound retries per-component (not per-bundle) otherwise an infinite loop on one corrupted blob stalls everything.

Mike L: agree. proposal for thresholds:
- probe timeout: 30s
- max retries per blob: 5
- backoff: jittered exp base 2, cap 10m

Elaine C: sample operator policy snippet:

```
activation:
  probe_timeout: 30s
  max_blob_retries: 5
  backoff:
    multiplier: 2
    jitter: 0.3
    cap: 10m
  rebase_window: 2m
```

Raj P: how does the probe work offline? i mean in airgap the agent can't call external health endpoints.

Elaine C: probe is local-only. two phases:
1) filesystem + manifest checksum verify
2) dry-run activation sandbox that replays apply steps (no final swap), checks for ordering constraints

Sasha: dry-run sounds expensive. can we make it sampling-based? e.g., only dry-run first N components after resume.

Elaine C: yes. default sample=3, configurable. if sample fails, escalate to full dry-run and mark bundle as quarantined.

ops-bot: [auto] detected upload retries spike from region-onprem-10 — triggered alert.

Mike L: ops-bot — do we capture how many retries per-component? need telemetry to make thresholds useful.

Elaine C: yes. plan: emit events: blob_retry.count, blob_retry.last_error, activation.rebase.count, activation.quarantine.reason. dashboard per-customer.

Raj P: what about operator flow to recover quarantined bundles? manual override API? rollback?

Elaine C: add an operator endpoint:
- POST /v1/operator/quarantine/{bundle_id}/inspect -> returns sample logs
- POST /v1/operator/quarantine/{bundle_id}/release -> re-enqueue with stricter probe + admin approval

Sasha: and ACLs? only SRE or tenant-admin can release. audit log required.

Elaine C: yep KMS-signed operator actions + audit entry for every release.

Mike L: edge-case: if probe keeps failing because of corrupted seed on USB import, auto-release will just re-loop. need human-in-the-loop after X auto-releases.

Elaine C: add limiter: max_auto_release = 1 per 24h per bundle. after that, needs manual signoff.

Raj P: rollback plan for bad rebase: we should keep pre-activation snapshot for 24h, allow fast rollback via operator endpoint.

Elaine C: agreed. snapshot retention config + quick rollback endpoint documented.

Sasha: doc note — call out cost: dry-run IO + snapshot storage. include budgeting guidance in RFC.

Elaine C: will add to RFC draft. next steps:
- update onprem agent to support dry-run sandbox (Raj)
- add telemetry hooks and dashboard (Mike)
- operator endpoints + ACL/audit (Sasha)
- write runbook: quarantined bundle inspection + safe-release playbook (Elaine)

Mike L: timeline? can we stagger rollout: opt-in flagged by default off for GA on-prem.

Elaine C: yes opt-in. plan: alpha in 2 weeks (internal), beta for a few customers after opt-in, GA after 3 months.

Raj P: +1. I'll prototype the dry-run shim — simple filesystem-only mode first.

Sasha: I'll sketch RBAC + audit schema.

Elaine C: awesome. filing an RFC update with these specifics now. ping me if you want to pair on telemetry names.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy started for onprem-agent v0.42-alpha (flag: offline-probe)

Mike L: nice. let's keep tight observability on canary.

Elaine C: thanks all :rocket:
